meta.name: blog-locale-audit
meta.description: Audit a directory of multilingual blog content for completeness, consistency, hreflang correctness, meta-tag parity, and freshness. Builds a translation coverage matrix, flags stale translations, validates hreflang and schema, and emits a prioritized report with runnable fix commands. Use when user says "locale audit", "blog locale-audit", "check translations", "multilingual audit", "translation check", "hreflang check", "Uebersetzungen pruefen".

copy.tagline: 检查多语言博客的翻译完整性和一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理多语言博客，需要确保翻译覆盖和hreflang正确。
